policy: Pre-SFT source-use registry. RAG sources may be usable for retrieval while still being unsuitable for model training. Anything marked citation_only must not be copied into SFT rows.

sources.name: SoilWise Soil Health Knowledge Graph
sources.notes: Open RDF KG; keep provenance on each retrieved document.

sources.name: AGROVOC
sources.notes: FAO vocabulary; large multilingual SKOS source. Prefer concept labels, synonyms, and relations for RAG/query expansion.

sources.name: Crop Ontology
sources.notes: Crop trait/variable ontologies; useful for crop phenotyping, trait names, growth stages, and breeding/variety context.

sources.name: USDA NAL Agricultural Thesaurus
sources.notes: Useful for agriculture term normalization. Verify exact current license terms before SFT use.

sources.name: USDA NRCS SSURGO / Soil Data Access
sources.license: US government data; cite NRCS/Web Soil Survey
sources.notes: Better as a live/geospatial tool than static training data. Must preserve scale limitations and map-unit uncertainty.

sources.name: Certified Crop Adviser Performance Objectives
sources.notes: Use to design original eval items and coverage maps. Do not train on copied passages.

sources.name: AI71 AgriLLM training and eval datasets
sources.notes: Schema supported. Needs row-quality filters and commercial-use review before serious training.

sources.name: DigiGreen Kenya agriculture queries
sources.notes: Custom CSV loader required because hosted files have inconsistent columns through datasets.load_dataset.

sources.name: Product labels and registrations
sources.notes: Keep as retrieval/tool source with date, jurisdiction, crop/site, and label version. Avoid baking label text into adapters.
